posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina is among the Bollywood actresses serving major yellow fashion inspiration this summer, while fans celebrate her son Vihaan Kaushal's first birthday with heartfelt birthday greetings to Vicky.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit creates history as the first Indian musician to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden, while his film Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali generates massive buzz.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia is set to play an assassin in YRF's edgy Alpha origin story and recently challenged the Indian film industry's male-viewer focus at Cannes, asking 'Why can't we make films for all genders?'

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka visited Mahesh Babu's AMB Cinemas amid growing buzz around SS Rajamouli's Varanasi, while a set photo from the Ugrabhatti caves sequence has surfaced online.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Visa has appointed Shah Rukh Khan as its brand ambassador for India, while Karan Johar's surprise Instagram unfollow spree — later clarified as a 'digital detox' — made SRK part of the biggest Bollywood talking point.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena wrapped shooting for Meghna Gulzar's Daayra alongside Prithviraj Sukumaran, and is reportedly in talks for a Salman Khan superhero film directed by Raj and DK.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's fun pajama dance video to Michael Jackson's 'Bad' went viral, with her caption hinting at rumoured beau Rahul Mody. She's also reportedly joining Aamir Khan in an Ashneer Grover biopic.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh and is using a body double for action in Allu Arjun's Raaka, while still filming intense combat scenes for SRK's King.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer faces an FWICE non-cooperation directive over his Don 3 exit amid reports of ₹45 crore losses, while Salman Khan steps in to broker peace. His next film Pralay starts filming in August regardless.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya and daughter Aaradhya continue to serve mother-daughter goals, recently spotted twinning in black at Mumbai airport after the actress's stunning Cannes appearances.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika represented India at the Global Anime Awards in Tokyo for the second time, while the Cocktail 2 trailer with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon is set to drop on May 29.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha married filmmaker Raj Nidimoru in a private ceremony and is gearing up for her new film Maa Inti Bangaaram, while her husband was spotted picking her up from the airport after a mobbing incident.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's Raaka with Atlee is progressing with Deepika Padukone, while his next project AA23 with Lokesh Kanagaraj boasts 'global appeal.' Delhi HC recently protected his personality rights.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's highly anticipated sports drama Peddi releases June 4 with AR Rahman's soundtrack. The film has already crossed $300K in North America pre-sales and Chiranjeevi personally secured theater deals.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR paid tribute to his grandfather NTR on his 103rd birth anniversary at NTR Ghat. His upcoming film Dragon with Prashanth Neel features 'Luger' — described as the director's 'darkest and most risky creation.'

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in the ₹350 crore sports drama Peddi releasing June 4, and recently reflected on 'Superwoman' Sridevi buying pomfrets at the fish market, crediting her mother's goodwill for opportunities.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya responded to Bharatanatyam fusion criticism by revealing she mutes negative Instagram accounts to manage anxiety, and recently celebrated her 27th birthday with B-town wishes from Kareena, Varun, and others.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara shared strict filming guidelines she had to follow on a challenging set, and stole the spotlight at the Nita Ambani Cultural Centre anniversary event in a stunning pink saree with husband Sidharth Malhotra.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: War 2's first look teaser featuring Hrithik and Jr NTR has sparked massive buzz, with Telugu distributors offering ₹100 crore for the film. The spy thriller is set for an August 14 Independence Day release.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's romantic comedy Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with dad David Dhawan locks June 5 release after Yash's Toxic postponement. He thanked Yash and Maddock Films for 'helping reset the calendar.'

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal announces 'The Unstoppable Tour' across US cities including Boston, Newark, Virginia, and Grand Prairie, with 17 upcoming dates lined up for fans worldwide.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman poses with Ram Charan as the duo head to Bhopal for the Peddi song launch. He's also co-producing Shekhar Kapur's Masoom sequel and composing the ambitious Ramayana soundtrack.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's TVK party won 108 seats in Tamil Nadu elections in a blockbuster political debut. His final film Jana Nayagan is now set for a June release, with the title 'People's Leader' mirroring his real-life rise.
